meta.issuingAuthority: Department of Immigration and Emigration, Sri Lanka

fields.label: Date of Arrival
fields.hint: Select your planned arrival date in Sri Lanka in YYYY-MM-DD format (e.g. 2026-10-15). Ensure it matches your flight ticket.
fields.warning: You cannot enter Sri Lanka before this date. Ensure it is correct as it cannot be modified after submission.

fields.label: Special Request
fields.hint: Enter any special requests, additional comments, or specific travel notes if applicable (maximum 1000 characters). Leave blank if none.
fields.example: Traveling with a group under tour booking reference G-9821.

fields.label: Full Name
fields.hint: Enter your full name EXACTLY as printed on the bio-data page of your passport. Use CAPITAL letters. Do not use initials unless they are printed in your passport.
fields.warning: Spelling must be 100% identical to your passport. Any spelling or order mismatch will lead to boarding rejection or entry denial.

fields.label: Date of Birth
fields.hint: Enter your date of birth in YYYY-MM-DD format matching your passport.
fields.warning: Verify the year, month, and day order carefully to match your passport bio page.

fields.label: Address
fields.hint: Enter your complete residential address in your home country. Include flat/house number, street name, city, state, and postal code.
fields.example: Flat 402, Sunrise Apartments, Sector 15, Rohini, New Delhi, 110089, India

fields.label: Email Address
fields.hint: Enter your primary email address. The approved Sri Lanka ETA document and receipt will be sent here.
fields.warning: Check for typos. An incorrect email address means you will not receive your approved ETA or reference number.

fields.label: Mobile/Cell Telephone - Country Code
fields.hint: Select your country code from the dropdown (e.g., +91 for India).

fields.label: Mobile/Cell Telephone - Number
fields.hint: Enter your active mobile number in the text box without spaces or leading zeroes.
fields.warning: Provide a valid number where immigration authorities can contact you in case of any queries.

fields.label: Passport Number
fields.hint: Enter your passport number exactly as shown in the top right of your passport bio page (e.g., Z1234567). Do not add spaces or special characters.
fields.warning: Check character by character. Do not confuse '0' (number) with 'O' (letter), or '1' with 'I'. A mismatch will lead to boarding denial.

fields.label: Nationality
fields.hint: Select your current country of citizenship as printed in your passport.

fields.label: Type of ETA
fields.hint: Select the specific type of ETA you are applying for (e.g., Tourist ETA - Double Entry 30 days).
